historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot page history: keep the history option row within the mobile viewport.
historical_adaptations.rationale: The verbatim upstream history-form rule lays the option cells out past the mobile viewport on the SCP-JP Sigma-9 target (delta receipt: target overflow at 320px and 390px without this block, zero at every measured width 320-1440px with it, and no collateral geometry change). Equal flexible columns keep all six history options inside the viewport; the correction is runtime-independent.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot redtape mobile submenu: list the mobile submenu in a single column like the target menu instead of a two-column grid with a dangling empty cell.
historical_adaptations.rationale: The inherited BHL mobile rule lays the top-bar submenu out as a two-column grid (grid-template-columns:repeat(2,50%)); the SCP-JP target menu has 17 items, so the grid leaves a dangling empty translucent cell at the bottom right (defect Q1-9), while the target Sigma menu is a single-column list. The same-target delta receipt shows this block restores a single column at 320/390px and leaves the desktop submenu template unchanged.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot redtape credit heritage: give the heritage rating module the dark pill ground of the target composition so its label stays readable in the credit modal.
historical_adaptations.rationale: In the credit modal the heritage rating module box computes to the theme background (rgb(252,252,252)) because --rating-module-bg-color resolves to --swatch-background (white monochrome), while the target composition shows the heritage module as a dark pill and the campaign pilot shows redtape label text failing against the white box (defect Q1-7; the F5 comparison in the W02 triage found the box background itself divergent, so this is not the F5 identical state). The same-target delta receipt shows this block gives the modal module the theme dark accent ground (rgb(70,13,13)) with the on-dark text color (label contrast 8.9) and leaves the page-level heritage module unchanged. The pilot cascade balance differs from the fixture frame on the label color source, so the block sets both the ground and the text variables; full verification at the Sigma-9 recapture. W13 (G2-13): the nested .page-rate-widget-box kept its own light ground inside the darkened module, leaving the rate segment white-on-white in the modal; the block now also clears the widget ground to transparent and sets its text to the on-dark color (W13 delta receipt: widget background rgb(252,252,252) -> transparent, rate-points color -> rgb(252,252,252) on the dark pill; screenshot-verified).

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot redtape dialog headings: keep dialog body headings on the dialog text color so they stay readable on the white dialog ground.
historical_adaptations.rationale: Two redtape-authored choices collide in dialogs: its own owindow rule forces the dialog ground white, while its variable block sets --swatch-text-tertiary-color to the white accent, and the shared BHL rule colors dialog body headings rgb(var(--modal-body-header-txt)) = the tertiary color — measured heading rgb(244,244,244) on white, contrast 1.1 (defect Q1-8; the BHL reference computes a dark heading at 17.79). Redefining --modal-body-header-txt to the dialog own text color (bright accent) inside the owindow scope restores a readable heading (measured 5.9) with body text unchanged.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot BHL credit otherwise correction: keep the back link on one line in the otherwise credit dialog.
historical_adaptations.rationale: In the otherwise credit dialog the back link (戻る) is a flex item beside the credit label pseudo-element; the row shrinks it to one glyph width (18px), so the two glyphs stack (defect Q1-1, BHL family). The same-target delta receipt shows the link at two lines and the row at 47.5px tall without the correction, and one line (row 28px) with white-space:nowrap and flex-shrink:0 on the link, with no collateral geometry change at 320-1440px.
